1) 从告警标签取 backend 与 server，登录该后端主机确认应用进程: 1) Take backend and server from the alert labels and log in to that backend host to confirm the application process and port are alive; 2) curl the backend address from the HAProxy host to tell an application failure apart from a network problem; 3) For an application failure, follow that application's own recovery procedure, then confirm HAProxy has automatically added it back (haproxy_server_up returns to 1); 4) Run echo 'show stat' | socat stdio /var/run/haproxy.sock to see how many servers are still available in the backend, and scale out immediately if headroom is low.
1) 从告警标签取 backend 名，先确认是所有 server 都在报错还是: 1) Take the backend name from the alert labels and first determine whether every server is erroring or only one (compare haproxy_server_http_responses_total{code="5xx"}); 2) If it is one server, remove it from the backend to stop the bleeding; 3) If all of them are erroring, check the backend application logs for the root cause (dependency timeouts, exhausted connection pool, a bug from a release); 4) If it lines up with a recent release, roll back first rather than keep investigating.
1) 从告警标签取 backend 名，对比 haproxy_backend_h: 1) Take the backend name from the alert labels and compare haproxy_backend_http_connect_time_average_seconds with http_queue_time_average_seconds to tell slow connects, long queueing and slow backend processing apart; 2) For long queueing, handle it as request queueing (raise maxconn or scale out); 3) For slow processing, investigate on the application side (slow queries, GC, downstream timeouts); 4) You may raise timeout server temporarily so requests are not cut off while you investigate, but do not treat it as a long-term fix.
1) 从告警标签取 backend 名，对照 haproxy_backend_h: 1) Take the backend name from the alert labels and compare with haproxy_backend_http_response_time_average_seconds to tell a slower backend apart from rising concurrency; 2) If the backend got slower, investigate on the application side (slow queries, GC, dependency timeouts); 3) If concurrency rose, check whether maxconn on the backend and its servers is set too low, raise it and reload; 4) If backend capacity is genuinely insufficient, add more servers.
1) 从告警标签取 backend 名，执行 echo 'show stat': 1) Take the backend name from the alert labels and run echo 'show stat' | socat stdio /var/run/haproxy.sock to see the state and down reason of every server in that backend; 2) curl each backend address from the HAProxy host to tell a collective backend failure apart from a HAProxy-to-backend network problem; 3) If the backends are healthy, check whether the backend's check configuration (probe path, timeout, rise/fall) is too aggressive; 4) If it cannot be recovered quickly, switch traffic to a standby backend or a degraded page.
1) 从告警标签取 backend 名，用 echo 'show stat' |: 1) Take the backend name from the alert labels and run echo 'show stat' | socat stdio /var/run/haproxy.sock to see which server's connection errors are growing; 2) telnet or curl that backend address from the HAProxy host to tell a closed port, a refused connection and a connect timeout apart; 3) If the backend process is healthy, check the network in between, the security groups, and whether the backend's backlog/somaxconn is saturated; 4) Check whether the backend's timeout connect is set too short and causing false positives.
1) 从告警标签取 frontend 名，确认是业务量自然增长还是遭遇异常流量（: 1) Take the frontend name from the alert labels and determine whether this is natural traffic growth or abnormal traffic (slow connections, crawlers); 2) For natural growth, raise the frontend maxconn and the global maxconn, confirm the system ulimit -n and memory are sufficient, then reload; 3) For abnormal traffic, add a stick-table rate limit on the frontend or block the source IPs outright; 4) Check whether many connections are sitting idle for a long time and tighten timeout client.
1) 登录主机执行 systemctl status haproxy 确认进程是: 1) Log in to the host and run systemctl status haproxy to confirm the process is alive; 2) If it is alive, verify the stats endpoint by hand with curl -s http://<host>:<port>/stats\;csv and check whether an ACL or firewall is blocking it; 3) If it is not running, validate the config first with haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg, then start it and check /var/log/haproxy.log for the exit reason; 4) Confirm the VIP layer (keepalived or similar) has failed over, otherwise move traffic to the standby node by hand.
HAProxy backend 响应时间过高: HAProxy backend response time too high
HAProxy frontend 会话数逼近上限: HAProxy frontend sessions approaching the limit
HAProxy 连接后端服务器时出现错误，部分请求没能送达后端就已失败，用户侧表: HAProxy is hitting errors when connecting to backend servers; some requests fail before ever reaching a backend and users see 503s.
backend 中有单台服务器健康检查失败被摘出，剩余节点要承担它的流量，节点接: A single server in the backend failed its health check and was taken out of rotation; the remaining nodes must absorb its traffic, and further nodes dropping out will take the whole backend down.
backend 已连续 5 分钟有请求在排队，说明后端处理能力跟不上或连接数配额: The backend has had requests queueing for 5 minutes, which means backend capacity or the connection quota is insufficient and clients experience noticeable waiting.
backend 最近 1024 个请求的平均响应时间已连续 5 分钟超过 1 秒: The backend's average response time over the last 1024 requests has been above 1 second for 5 minutes; users can clearly feel the lag.
backend 返回的 5xx 占比已连续 3 分钟超过 5%，说明后端服务正在: The share of 5xx responses from the backend has been above 5% for 3 minutes, which means the backend service is failing broadly and users are already seeing errors.
frontend 当前会话数已达 maxconn 上限的 80%，触顶后新连接会: Frontend sessions have reached 80% of the maxconn limit; once it tops out HAProxy rejects new connections outright and clients see connection timeouts.
整个 backend 被标记为 DOWN，说明该 backend 下已没有任何可: The whole backend is marked DOWN, which means it has no available servers left and every request hitting this backend returns 503.
采集端已连续 1 分钟拉不到 HAProxy 的 stats，HAProxy 进: The collector has not been able to scrape HAProxy stats for 1 minute; the HAProxy process may have exited and all traffic it forwards would be interrupted.
